audit_method: The runner's scoped cleanup helper queries Win32_Process for msedge.exe command lines containing the exact generated profile path until none remain, then calls the existing validated profile deletion helper. Each run record reports profile_cleaned=true and errors=[]. The random profile marker is not separately serialized, so no independent post-run process query was possible.
